newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rodamco in talks to buy Barclays' Imry.
newsitem.headline: Rodamco in talks to buy Barclays' Imry.

text.p: Dutch fund management group Robeco said on Wednesday it could confirm that its Rodamco NV property arm was in detailed talks to buy property development firm Imry Holdings from British bank Barclays Plc.
"I can confirm that we are in detailed negotiations on this," Robeco spokesman Hans de Klerk told Reuters.
But he declined to provide more details.

Britain's The Times newspaper reported on Wednesday that Rodamco was discussing an offer believed to be worth up to 450 million pounds for Imry, which Barclays rescued during the British property crash of the early 1990s.
Imry owns a shopping centre in Leceister, central England, and a big development site in Southampton, in the south.
The Times said talks were likely to be protracted and focus on the cost of building the Southampton centre.
